brief.en: Breaks 1 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it
brief.zh: 对走过的僵尸造成伤害，并破坏 1 个滚动的物体

description.en: Spikeweeds destroy one rolling zombie and hurt any zombies that step on them.
description.zh: 地刺摧毁一滚动前行的目标，并且对经过的僵尸造成伤害。

chat.en: Although Spikeweed grew up on the seedy side of town, his acupuncture business has been blooming.
chat.zh: 尽管地刺在村里的播种地长大，他的针灸事业也在蓬勃发展。

text.zh: 会被滚动前行的僵尸摧毁
